title: Projection onto a coordinate set
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. For $x\in\Omega^n$, define its projection onto functions of the coordinates in $J$ by averaging $f$ over an independent product-distributed input $y$, while retaining $x$ on $J$: $P_Jf(x)=\mathbb E_{y\sim\pi^{\otimes n}} f(z)$, where $z_i=x_i$ for $i\in J$ and $z_i=y_i$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$J$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
